subject: Alternative billing pilot request — Evergreen Labs (quarterly + Net-90)
messages:
From: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@evergreenlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Evergreen Labs is excited about the integration. Before we proceed to the contract signature, our finance team has asked whether Redwood would consider a short-term pilot on alternative invoicing: consolidate monthly invoices into a single quarterly invoice and extend payment terms to Net-90 for the first two quarters of our engagement.

Background: we receive major grant disbursements on a quarterly cadence and have a temporary shortfall this fiscal year. Evergreen is prepared to provide a customer PO and a purchase order line referencing Redwood services immediately. We’d like Redwood to invoice quarterly and move to Net-90 for Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 while we align cashflow.

Can you let me know if this is something you can support, and if so what approvals you’d need? We’re happy to accept limited safeguards (e.g., usage caps, credit checks, pre-funded retention, or a nominal early-pay discount) to make this workable for Redwood.

Attached: Evergreen_PO.pdf (pdf) — draft PO.

Best,
Amy Jenkins
CFO, Evergreen Labs
amy.jenkins@evergreenlabs.com
(415) 555-0198
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@evergreenlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and the PO. I appreciate the context.

Short answer: we can consider a time-limited alternative billing cadence, but it requires approval from finance and an exec sign-off given the extended payment window. I’ve looped in Laura (finance) to run a quick credit/org check and Rishi for commercial oversight.

Possible mitigations we typically ask for:
- Signed PO covering the pilot period (you included the draft; thank you)
- Usage cap or calendar-based spend limit for the pilot (e.g., cap at $150k per quarter)
- 1.5% early-pay discount if paid within 60 days to incentivize faster settlement
- Credit references and an initial 15% holdback or rolling reserve if needed

If you’re amenable to one or more of these, I’ll escalate to Finance + Execs for conditional approval. Let me know which mitigations work for you and I’ll move this through.

Best,
David
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
(650) 555-2368

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot — Evergreen Labs — request for sign-off

Team — forwarding Evergreen’s ask. Summary: Evergreen (CFO Amy Jenkins) requests a 6-month pilot (Q4 2026 + Q1 2027) where Redwood would:
- Consolidate invoices to a single quarterly invoice
- Accept Net-90 payment terms for the pilot window
- Provide a PO now to start onboarding

Proposed mitigations I suggest we require:
1) Signed PO for the pilot period (attached)
2) Quarterly spend cap of $150k, after which services revert to standard monthly invoicing and prepay or immediate suspension
3) 15% rolling reserve to be returned after the pilot if payments are on time
4) 1.5% early-pay discount if Evergreen pays within 60 days

Laura — can you run a credit and banking reference check? Rishi — are you comfortable with a conditional commercial approval if finance signs off on credit? Jonas — will need exec sign-off for Net-90 exposure > $100k.

Attachments: redwood-draft-mop_evergreen.xlsx (xlsx), Evergreen_PO.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — David

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: quarterly invoicing + Net-90 pilot — Evergreen Labs — request for sign-off

David — I ran a quick check on Evergreen. They are a mid-stage nonprofit with solid grant history but limited operating cash on hand per their most recent filings. Two asks from Finance before we recommend approval to Jonas:

1) Evergreen needs to provide the signed PO with the legal entity name and a primary billing contact (Kevin Park is listed; need phone and billing email).
2) We want a short-term credit facility in the contract: 15% rolling reserve held against invoices during the pilot. If Evergreen agrees, we’ll set the credit limit at $300k for the pilot window.

If both are provided, I’m comfortable moving to recommend conditional approval: quarterly invoices + Net-90 for the two-quarter pilot with the reserve and a monitoring cadence. Rishi — commercial ok? Jonas — please sign off if you agree to the exposure and the reserve approach.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Approved (conditional).

Decision summary: Redwood will allow a two-quarter pilot (Q4 2026 + Q1 2027) with the following conditions:
- Evergreen provides a signed PO with legal entity and primary billing contact before onboarding
- 15% rolling reserve retained against each quarterly invoice for the duration of the pilot; reserve released at pilot completion provided invoices are paid by Net-90
- Quarterly spend cap set to $150,000 (exposure above that reverts to standard terms)
- Evergreen will receive a 1.5% early-pay discount if they pay within 60 days; otherwise Net-90 applies
- Finance to run banking references and confirm ACH/payment instructions prior to first invoice

Laura — please capture these terms in the Master Order Form and loop in Legal for the amendment language (pilot & reserve mechanics). David — please communicate the conditions back to Amy and request the signed PO + billing contact. Rishi — keep commercial on the engagement.

Jonas Weber
VP, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
